description: Telefonía fija comercial is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by URSEC. El siguiente conjunto presenta los datos sobre la cantidad de líneas de telefonía fija a nivel comercial instaladas por cada departamento de la Reública Oriental del Uruguay. Se presenta la serie historica con datos mensuales desde el año 2015 a la fecha. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher URSEC. Its tags are Líneas telefónicas, Telecomunicaciones, Telefonía, Telefonía comercial. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-02-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
